subject: Refine the purpose of rdb saving with accurate flags (#12925)
reason: The change only passes more accurate RDBFLAGS values into save functions, but no save-path code consumes RDBFLAGS_REPLICATION on this checkout: rdbSaveInfoAuxFields and rdbSaveDb test only RDBFLAGS_AOF_PREAMBLE, rdbSaveInternal tests only RDBFLAGS_KEEP_CACHE, and startSaving's module-subevent selection tests only RDBFLAGS_AOF_PREAMBLE and the pid (no rdbSave caller passes AOF_PREAMBLE; the AOF rewrite calls rdbSaveRio directly).
